description: This file implements a thread-safe rate limiting mechanism using a token bucket algorithm. It defines a class 'TokenBucket' with methods to manage token addition and consumption, suitable for controlling request rates in concurrent environments.

classes.name: TokenBucket
classes.description: A thread-safe token bucket class for rate limiting, supporting token refilling based on elapsed time and safe concurrent token consumption.

methods.name: None __init__(self, rate_per_sec: float, capacity: int)
methods.description: Initializes a TokenBucket instance with specified rate per second and capacity, sets initial tokens to capacity.

methods.name: None _refill(self)
methods.description: Refills tokens based on elapsed time since last update, respecting maximum capacity.

methods.name: bool try_consume(self, n: int = 1)
methods.description: Attempts to consume a specified number of tokens. Returns True if successful, False otherwise.
